LOVERS-FIGHT.note: Bound HIM=FRAN, HER=JOSHUA yet subgoals print JOSHUA first. Mapping of roles to subgoal arguments cannot be fixed from one run. Final subgoal churns further, as L87 p. 236 says most churn fragments do.

observations: Candidate list is printed after constraint filtering ('filtering out those with constraints that are not met', L87 p. 238).
Both bindings of genderless roles are listed (fn. 2).
JOB-PROBLEM binds JOB to the stereotype of the character with the problem (Fran: BUREAUCRAT; Joshua: SLEAZY-LAWYER).
Second candidate list is in a different order from the first, order is not stable across calls (hash/order of indexing?). Not reproducible exactly.
COLLEAGUE is a deferred role filled after selection with JACK (a character not in Fig. 1).
